findings.evidence: Blink without expression evidence is evidenceInsufficient → review; expressions are not issued unless the provider supports landmarks.
Same-sign turns are reviewed by default and rejected when consistency is enforced; two frames per action is insufficient evidence.
A frontal live frame cannot vouch for a zero-liveness turned frame — pose is judged on frames that clear the spoof floor.
NaN passive score rejects; unavailable identity routes to review.
Excluding every head movement throws instead of issuing an expression-only or empty challenge.
A challenge issued in the future is not fresh.

Flash sequences are server-issued (challenge.flashSequence); the upload rejects any other sequence and the worker verifies HMAC, dimensions and per-tile identity before scoring (see pipeline scenario below).
Two-argument uploadLivenessFrame reports captureMode 'unknown' (server treats it as manual → review), never 'auto'.
A genuine burst (3 distinct frames per action, opposite-signed yaw) approves in production with the policy declared validated.
Selfie 0.01 with 0.95 frontal frames is contradictory evidence → manual review, never approval; the persisted score is the selfie's.
enforceFlash with no mosaic keeps enforced:true and routes to review.
Identity comparison failure routes to review, never approval.
Result write failure rolls back the status CAS, audit and outbox; the session stays submitted for retry.
A worker holding attempt A evidence cannot finalize attempt B submitted during inference.
